note: DSEWiki pages reached by the Internet Archive's crawl through the prowiki.org alias whose names match the swarm signature regexes in data/wiki_candidates.json. in_export: a revision with this page name exists in the public export's dse cut. archived_state 'empty' = the capture shows ProWiki's new-page placeholder (a handle or link the crawler followed, never a saved page); 'content' = the capture holds a saved body that the export has no revision for under this name.
